About BOBBY

Who We Are

BOBBY AC REPAIR & HOME APPLIANCE SERVICES is a local doorstep service provider based in Narasaraopet, Palnadu District, Andhra Pradesh – 522601.

  • We specialise in AC repair, servicing, installation, uninstallation and refrigerant-related services for split and window air conditioners.
  • Our services also cover refrigerators, washing machines, air coolers, ceiling fans and selected minor household electrical repair and maintenance works.

From AC cooling problems to everyday household appliance breakdowns, we aim to bring multiple cooling appliance service, repair and maintenance solutions under one roof, saving you the effort of contacting different service providers for different household needs.

  • One Local Service Partner.
  • Multiple Home Solutions.
  • Your Trust, Our Priority.

Our Service Philosophy

Diagnose Correctly. Repair Carefully. Deliver Dependable Service.

DiagnoseRepairDeliver

We believe good service begins with understanding the actual problem. Every appliance issue deserves proper inspection, an appropriate solution and responsible workmanship. Our focus is not simply to get an appliance running again, but to identify the underlying issue and recommend the right course of action.

How We Work

Our Trust Principles

  1. 01

    Inspect Before Repair

    We identify the actual cause of the problem before recommending repairs or component replacements.

  2. 02

    Explain Before Proceeding

    We explain the identified issue and recommended solution in simple language.

  3. 03

    Estimate Before Work

    We communicate applicable charges and estimates before starting any work. Customer approval is required before proceeding.

  4. 04

    No Unnecessary Repairs

    We recommend work based on inspection findings rather than suggesting unnecessary replacements or refrigerant charging.

  5. 05

    Responsible Workmanship

    We use appropriate tools and follow suitable service procedures while handling appliances.

  6. 06

    Test Before Completion

    We check the appliance's operation after completing the agreed service and communicate any remaining issues.

  7. 07

    Respect Your Home

    We aim to maintain cleanliness, handle appliances carefully and leave the work area in a reasonable condition.
